_about: Creation Suite v2 theme manifest — the suite's skin is bound through these asset SLOTS, never hard-coded into CSS. Each slot records what file fills it, which game it was extracted from, the exact in-holdings source path, and how it was extracted. status meanings: 'extracted' = a real file from a held teardown, viewed and content-verified by the v2 lane; 'pending-t7' = slot reserved for the Tekken 7 front-end drop landing piecewise via gap-closure W6 (swap the file + this record, no code change); 'reconstruction' = we hold no such file, so the slot renders the labeled CSS fallback in suite2.css and must never be presented as file-derived.

icons._about: Row/section icons: WWF No Mercy edit-mode (CAW) tab graphics — in that game the edit-mode categories ARE these text-tab images. Content-verified by viewing each file.

fightingStyle.extraction: GitHub contents API 2026-10-21; PNG 80x16, reads 'FIGHTING STYLE'.

arrowNext.extraction: No arrow glyph file verified in holdings; CSS chevron stands, labeled.

arrowPrev.extraction: No arrow glyph file verified in holdings; CSS chevron stands, labeled.

cursor.extraction: Repo ROM texture dump (PNG 64x32, content-verified: the '1P' marker). Fetched via GitHub contents API 2026-10-21. Bound as the equipped/current-selection marker in list rows — the character-select marker's own job.

fontDisplay.extraction: No game font has ever been extracted in holdings: T6's owfont .fnt/.ntx pair is referenced in the decrypted EBOOT only (locked in the bulk), No Mercy has a single PPV-name glyph sheet (not an alphabet), WMXIX/Def Jam hold no fonts. System condensed sans stands, labeled.

glyphConfirm.extraction: No button-glyph sheet exists in holdings (the No Mercy recomp promptfont.ttf is the recomp project's own font, NOT original game art — deliberately not bound). Text prompt chips stand, labeled.

headerPlate.extraction: No header plate graphic verified in holdings (the No Mercy lobby tile fetched for this slot proved to be an environment pattern texture on viewing, and was NOT bound). CSS fallback stands, labeled.

keyArt.extraction: Already extracted by the T6 teardown lane (PNG 480x272, byte-identical to the ISO file); copied from the lane's checkout 2026-10-21. Content-verified: Tekken 6 key art (Kazuya/Heihachi/Jin + logo). Bound as the fighter-select screen banner — PIC1 is the PSP's selection backdrop art.
keyArt.source: PSP_GAME/PIC1.PNG in the Tekken 6 PSP ISO (LBA 55360, 251,946 B) — extracted copy at wh/teardown/tekken6/ui/psp_PIC1.png in the T6 teardown lane

panelBg.extraction: No full-screen menu background exists as a file in any holding: No Mercy's backgrounds are 3D lobby scenes + small tiles (16x16/32x32), WMXIX holds zero front-end files, Def Jam SCREENS/ was never extracted, Tekken UI art is locked in undecodable T6 bulk containers / un-acquired T7 paks. CSS fallback stands, labeled.

panelFrame.extraction: Repo ROM texture dump (PNG, 32x32, content-verified: a black panel tile with a light frame border — the game's own framed-box tile). Fetched via GitHub contents API 2026-10-21. Bound as the menu panel's border-image.

stageBackdrop.extraction: The stage dressing (dark void + ring platform) is ours; both suites present the fighter on a simple stage, but no stage backdrop file exists in holdings. Labeled reconstruction.

t7DropIn.note: Tekken 7 front-end/UI pieces are landing piecewise (gap-closure W6, target set #2, straight to repo storage). When a T7 file lands it replaces the file for its slot here and this record flips to status 'extracted', game 'Tekken 7'. No CSS/JS change is needed — that is the point of the slot design.
